drawio._comment: Launchers for the LOCAL draw.io desktop app, used by the Diagram tab's edit button (the draw.io icon in the tab's top-right corner). Tried in order; the file being edited is appended to `args`. Each entry's `exe` is resolved before it is spawned, so an entry that is not installed on this machine is skipped with a message rather than failing the click, and all failures are reported together in the button's error. Point `exe` at your own install to use a non-default location.
drawio._platform: Optional per-entry `platform` tag: darwin | win32 | linux (macos/windows/posix also accepted). Entries for this machine's platform are tried first, then the untagged ones (file-association fallbacks) as a last resort. An entry for another OS is skipped; with no tag it is tried everywhere. Delete the entries you do not need, or add your own above the defaults.
